title: Yellow Turkish Chinese long beans Doner Kebab
description: A unique and flavorful Turkish dish featuring Chinese long beans, perfect for flexitarian foodies, this Doner Kebab is salty, aerated, and visually impressive. It is deep-fry-tod and kebab-doner in form.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and turmeric.
Add the trimmed Chinese long beans to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully add the coated Chinese long beans to the hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Remove the fried long beans from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Thread the fried long beans onto skewers, if desired, to form a kebab shape.
Serve the Yellow Turkish Chinese long beans Doner Kebab hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs or pickled vegetables, if desired.
To make the Doner Kebab style, stack the fried long beans vertically on a serving plate or platter and serve with a side of tangy sauce or yogurt sauce, if desired.
